errors.error: Dice shows Applied in log but no confirmation emails received
errors.root_cause: Self-hosted Mac Chrome 151 headless detected by Dice — silently rejects applications
errors.fix: Moved Dice back to ubuntu-latest (GitHub cloud) where it was confirmed working
errors.note: Rule: Dice MUST run on ubuntu-latest (cloud). Self-hosted Mac fails silently.

errors.error: 27 Applied in log but 0 confirmation emails — re-applying to same jobs
errors.root_cause: No dedup check. postedDate=THREE returns same jobs. cards[:10] limits variety. Dice silently ignores re-applications.
errors.fix: postedDate=ONE (today only), cards[:25], check for Already Applied badge before clicking
errors.note: Rule: Dice MUST check for Already Applied text before clicking Apply. Use postedDate=ONE for fresh jobs only.

errors.error: Counts applied after clicking submit button without verifying success
errors.root_cause: applied += 1 runs on button click, not on page confirmation. Dice may show Already Applied or redirect without submitting.
errors.fix: Added page_source check for confirmation text. Export unconfirmed jobs to dice_manual_jobs.json.
errors.note: Rule: NEVER count as applied without page text confirmation (application submitted / thank you / successfully applied).

errors.error: Cookies expire after 7 days, self-hosted runner unreliable (disconnects)
errors.root_cause: Indeed cookies are NOT refreshed unless used in a browser session. Self-hosted Mac sleeps/disconnects.
errors.fix: storage_state approach: load cookies → apply → save REFRESHED cookies back to GitHub Secret. Moved to ubuntu-latest (cloud). Cookies auto-renew on each run.
errors.note: Rule: Indeed cookies auto-refresh if USED daily. Save back to secret after every run. No laptop dependency.

errors.error: Cookies expired immediately on cloud runner
errors.root_cause: Indeed invalidates cookies when used from a DIFFERENT IP than where they were created. Laptop IP ≠ GitHub cloud IP = instant invalidation.
errors.fix: Indeed MUST run on self-hosted (same IP as cookie source) OR use email/password login in Playwright.
errors.note: Rule: Indeed cookies are IP-bound. Cannot transfer from laptop to cloud. Must either: (1) run on self-hosted, or (2) implement email+password login in Playwright with stealth.

errors.error: Only 2 VERIFIED out of 25 clicks — Dice silently rejects most Easy Apply clicks
errors.root_cause: Dice anti-bot detects automated clicks. Clicks the Apply button but Dice does not show confirmation page text. Only 2 actually went through.
errors.fix: Verification logic now correctly identifies this. 23 jobs exported to dice_manual_jobs.json for user.
errors.note: Rule: Dice Easy Apply has ~8% success rate from automation (2/25). Most jobs need manual apply. Export all unverified to manual list.

errors.error: state_file not defined + jjson not defined + workflow cant git push
errors.root_cause: Variable scope: state_file defined inside browser context block but referenced in cookie refresh block. Workflow missing permissions: contents: write.
errors.fix: Moved state_file to top of function scope. Fixed jjson→json. Added permissions: contents: write to both workflows.
errors.note: Rule: Define all file path variables at function top, not inside nested blocks. Workflows need explicit permissions for git push.

errors.error: Phase 3 crashed: cookies[0].secure: expected boolean, got number
errors.root_cause: Same cookie bool bug from Friday — never fixed in agent/cookie_agent.py and agent/src/applier.py (only fixed in indeed_apply.py)
errors.fix: Added bool() conversion in cookie_agent.py (line 85) and applier.py (lines 1490, 1557)
errors.note: Rule: EVERY add_cookies() call in EVERY file needs bool conversion. Check ALL files when fixing cookie issues.

errors.error: Timed out at 40 min — got 13 submitted but missed 48 more
errors.fix: Increased step timeout from 40 to 55 min
errors.root_cause: With 61 jobs to apply × ~45 sec each = 45 min needed. 40 min cap killed it.
errors.note: Rule: AI Agent needs 55 min minimum. 61 jobs × 45 sec = 45 min + buffer.

errors.error: 3 AI Agent runs cancelled — schedule overlap
errors.root_cause: 9 AI Agent + 8 Greenhouse = 17 runs/day on 1 runner. They cancelled each other.
errors.fix: Reduced to 4 AI Agent (7,10,1,4 MT) + 4 Greenhouse (8:30,11:30,2:30,5:30 MT). No overlaps.
errors.note: Rule: Max 8 self-hosted runs/day. Space by runtime (55+30=85 min pairs). Never schedule overlapping self-hosted jobs.

errors.error: Email verification codes not read — Greenhouse requires code entry
errors.root_cause: GMAIL_USER and GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD env vars missing from agent.yml workflow
errors.fix: Added both env vars. email_code_reader.py already existed — just needed credentials.
errors.note: Rule: ANY workflow that applies to Greenhouse MUST have GMAIL_USER + GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD for verification codes.

errors.error: Workflow file invalid YAML — could not run
errors.root_cause: Inline Python code edits (from Friday) broke YAML structure. permissions: block landed inside Python code.
errors.fix: Restored from last valid commit (78999ff). Lost dedup/verify features but at least runs.
errors.note: Rule: NEVER edit workflow files with string replacement when they contain inline Python. Use separate .py files instead.

errors.error: 16/51 jobs failed with Form errors: this field is required, 5_field_errors
errors.root_cause: ATS marks fields with aria-invalid=true AFTER submit — but bot only looked for required/aria-required BEFORE submit
errors.fix: Added aria-invalid detection in _fill_remaining_required. After submit failure, scans for invalid fields, fills them, retries.
errors.note: Rule: After submit failure, check aria-invalid=true fields (ATS validation markers). These fields may not have required attribute but still block submit.

errors.error: Phase 3c: No recruiter emails found for 78 email-only jobs
errors.root_cause: HUNTER_API_KEY, APOLLO_API_KEY, SNOV_USER_ID, SNOV_API_SECRET, RESEND_KEY — all existed in GitHub Secrets but were NEVER added to agent.yml env block.
errors.fix: Added all 5 keys to env block. Added preflight check step that warns if any key is missing.
errors.note: Rule: EVERY new feature that needs an API key MUST: (1) add to workflow env block, (2) be checked in preflight step. Never assume secrets are passed — VERIFY in workflow YAML.

errors.error: This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue (5 consecutive failures)
errors.root_cause: Em-dash character (—) in workflow name field. GitHub Actions rejects non-ASCII in name: field. YAML validates locally but GitHub remote parser rejects it.
errors.fix: Replaced — with - in name field. Rule: NEVER use non-ASCII characters anywhere in workflow YAML.
errors.note: Rule: Workflow YAML must be pure ASCII. No em-dashes, no unicode, no special chars in name/step fields. Local yaml.safe_load passes but GitHub rejects remotely. ALSO: duplicate env var keys cause silent rejection.

errors.error: Run stuck for 1.5 hours blocking ALL self-hosted jobs (Greenhouse, Indeed, next AI Agent)
errors.root_cause: Old run from before timeout fix had no step-level timeout. Job-level timeout was 50 min but did not kill the step. Runner only has 1 worker = everything queues.
errors.fix: Cancelled manually. Prevention: step timeout-minutes: 55 now in place. Also: always cancel runs older than 60 min.
errors.note: Rule: If a self-hosted run is stuck > 60 min, CANCEL it. It blocks everything. Check with: gh run list --status in_progress

errors.error: 16/51 form errors - radio buttons for authorization/sponsorship never filled
errors.root_cause: _fill_remaining_required explicitly excluded radio buttons: not([type=radio]). Greenhouse/Lever Yes/No questions (authorized to work, need sponsorship, relocate) are ALL radio buttons = always empty = always fail.
errors.fix: Added radio button group handler: detects fieldset with radios, reads question text, matches to yes/no patterns, clicks correct radio.
errors.note: Rule: Radio buttons are the #1 cause of form failures in ATS. NEVER exclude them from fill logic. Common ATS radio questions: authorized (Yes), sponsorship (No), relocate (No), background check (Yes), drug test (Yes).

errors.error: python: cant open file agent/agent/scripts/application_confirmations.py
errors.root_cause: Workflow has working-directory: agent/. I wrote agent/scripts/... which becomes agent/agent/scripts/... at runtime.
errors.fix: Changed to scripts/application_confirmations.py (relative to working dir)
errors.note: Rule: ALWAYS check working-directory in workflow BEFORE writing paths. If working-directory: agent/ then paths are RELATIVE to agent/.

patterns.self_hosted_mac: Never use actions/setup-python on self-hosted Mac. Always use venv.
patterns.timeouts: Never set step timeout higher than job timeout. Always add unbuffered output.
patterns.cookies: Google OAuth cannot be automated. Use email+password accounts for full automation.
patterns.captcha_services: Always auto-disable paid services after first balance error. Never retry 40 times.
patterns.file_paths: Always verify scripts referenced in workflows are actually committed to git.
patterns.chrome_selenium: ANY workflow using Selenium/Chrome/undetected-chromedriver MUST include webdriver-manager + ChromeDriverManager().install()
patterns.google_oauth: Google OAuth (Sign in with Google) CANNOT be automated. Requires one-time human click. Use email+password accounts for full automation.
patterns.runner_restart: After git push with workflow/code fixes, runner laptop MUST: git pull && ./svc.sh stop && ./svc.sh start. Old code stays cached until restart.
patterns.indeed_cookies: Indeed uses Google OAuth. Cannot auto-login. Must run scripts/indeed_auto_login.py ONCE per laptop.
patterns.cookie_types: Chrome SQLite stores booleans as int (0/1). ALWAYS convert to Python bool before Playwright/Selenium add_cookies().
patterns.dice_runner: Dice MUST run on ubuntu-latest. Self-hosted Mac headless Chrome gets silently rejected by Dice anti-bot.
patterns.dice_dedup: Dice does NOT prevent re-application at UI level — silently ignores. Script MUST check for Already Applied badge.
patterns.verify_apply: ALL platforms: clicking Submit is NOT proof of success. MUST check page text for confirmation keywords before counting as applied.
patterns.cookie_refresh: Indeed session cookies renew when used. Save context.storage_state() after each run and update GitHub Secret. Cookies stay valid indefinitely if bot runs daily.
patterns.cloud_over_selfhosted: Prefer ubuntu-latest over self-hosted for ALL workflows. Self-hosted is unreliable (sleep, WiFi, process death). Only use self-hosted if Chrome profile access is REQUIRED.
patterns.indeed_ip_bound: Indeed cookies are IP-BOUND. Extracting from laptop then using on cloud = instant expiration. Indeed MUST run on same network as cookie source OR use direct login.
patterns.dice_real_success_rate: Dice automated Easy Apply has ~8% real success rate. Anti-bot silently rejects most clicks. Always verify page text. Export unverified for manual apply.
patterns.parallel_self_hosted: Self-hosted runner has 1 worker. Jobs QUEUE, not parallel. Stagger schedules by runtime: AI Agent(40min) → Greenhouse(30min) → Indeed(10min). Never schedule 2 self-hosted jobs at same time.
patterns.stuck_job_handling: If a job hangs: timeout-minutes kills it. Next queued job starts after timeout. No auto-restart mechanism for runner itself. Health check every 2h monitors status.
patterns.solve_unsolved: Runs every 2h on cloud. Retries failed jobs from failed_jobs.json/unsolved_jobs.json. Uses Playwright. Max 5 jobs per run. Self-learning (learned_strategies.json).
patterns.cookie_bool_all_files: Cookie bool conversion must be in EVERY file that calls add_cookies(). Check: agent/cookie_agent.py, agent/src/applier.py, indeed_apply.py, any new file.
patterns.schedule_spacing: Self-hosted runner = 1 worker. Max 8 runs/day. AI Agent (55min) + Greenhouse (30min) = 85 min pair. Space pairs 90 min apart minimum.
patterns.inline_python_yaml: NEVER edit .yml workflow files containing inline Python with string replace. The indentation and special chars (quotes, colons) WILL break YAML. Use separate .py script files instead.
patterns.aria_invalid_fields: After submit failure: fields marked aria-invalid=true are the ones blocking. Scan these FIRST before retrying. They may not have required attribute.
patterns.gmail_for_greenhouse: Greenhouse sends email verification codes. Any workflow applying to Greenhouse MUST have GMAIL_USER + GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD env vars.
patterns.env_var_preflight: EVERY workflow MUST have a preflight step that checks ALL required env vars are set. Secrets exist in GitHub but are NOT automatically passed — they must be explicitly listed in the env: block. Missing key = silent feature failure.
patterns.recruiter_email_keys: Recruiter email finding needs: HUNTER_API_KEY, APOLLO_API_KEY, SNOV_USER_ID, SNOV_API_SECRET, RESEND_KEY. ALL must be in agent.yml env block. Without them Phase 3c silently returns 0 emails.
patterns.yaml_ascii_only: GitHub Actions workflow YAML must be 100% ASCII. Em-dash (—), unicode quotes, non-ASCII chars in name: or step names = instant parse failure. Local YAML validators DO NOT catch this. Always use plain hyphen (-).
patterns.workflow_debug_sequence: When workflow shows file issue: (1) check non-ASCII chars first, (2) check duplicate keys, (3) compare with last working git commit, (4) restore and re-apply changes one by one.
patterns.stuck_run_blocks_all: Self-hosted runner = 1 worker. ONE stuck run blocks ALL other self-hosted jobs (Indeed, Greenhouse, AI Agent). Always check in_progress runs and cancel any > 60 min. Prevention: timeout-minutes on EVERY step.
patterns.no_looping_checklist: Before fixing ANY issue: (1) Read memory first, (2) Check if same error exists in patterns, (3) If yes - apply known fix immediately, (4) If no - investigate then ADD to memory. Never fix same thing twice.
patterns.radio_buttons_ats: ATS forms use radio buttons for: work authorization (Yes), sponsorship needed (No), willing to relocate (No), background check (Yes), drug test (Yes), 18+ (Yes). These MUST be filled or form rejects. Match question text to yes/no patterns.
patterns.system_map_check: BEFORE investigating ANY issue: check system_map in memory first. It shows what exists, what talks to what, and where configs live. Prevents re-investigating known architecture.
patterns.never_hardcode_queries: Search queries MUST be dynamic (from search_queries.json or profile). NEVER hardcode a single query. System learns and rotates automatically.
patterns.vendor_is_automated: Vendor outreach is AUTOMATED: monthly email blast + weekly portal upload + auto-discovery from job scraping. Do NOT manually manage vendor list — it grows from find_jobs.py.
patterns.verify_before_push: MANDATORY before EVERY git push: (1) python syntax check, (2) YAML valid, (3) verify file paths EXIST on disk, (4) check working-directory in workflow, (5) no duplicate keys. NEVER push without verification. One bad push = 5 min wasted waiting for failure.
patterns.working_directory_paths: If workflow has working-directory: X/ then ALL paths in run: are RELATIVE to X/. Writing X/scripts/foo.py becomes X/X/scripts/foo.py = file not found. Check FIRST.
patterns.recruiter_pipeline_tracking: Every recruiter conversation is tracked through stages. Pipeline auto-advances based on email keywords. Silent recruiters get follow-up after 3 days. Never lose a conversation.

rules_for_new_workflows: Use venv (python3 -m venv) — never bare pip install
Add webdriver-manager for any Selenium/Chrome workflow
Set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 for real-time CI output
Add timeout-minutes to both job level AND long-running steps
Exit with code 1 on actual failure (not silent success)
Save failures to agent/data/failed_jobs.json for retry
